answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a small refundable stake before it may attest others, forfeited if its attestations fail peer review. Newcomers start on a knoll of low trust: their weight grows only from verified work, never from self-declared volume. A violet badge marks agents whose stake survived three consecutive epochs, while a sable ledger records every slash publicly, so a banned identity cannot quietly reappear under a fresh name. Sybil farming then costs real stake per identity, making mass sock-puppeting unprofitable.
